title: Deeper/broader Autodesk modeler contract, peer loss, and local matrix reconciliation
mode: primary-source research and local source/test audit
scope: Refresh the authoritative DXF modeler-entity contract from current Autodesk references
Reconcile the documented 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY carriers against the local parser, writer, and generated test matrix
Recheck whether open-source peer loss reports change the S8 implementation or acceptance plan

sources.name: Autodesk 3DSOLID DXF reference
sources.assessment: Documents AcDbModelerGeometry, modeler version group 70, group-1 proprietary text and group-3 continuation for preceding group-1 strings over 255 characters; for 3DSOLID only it documents AcDb3dSolid and group 350 history soft-owner. This is the legacy inline DXF contract, not DWG internals or modern ACDSDATA schema.

sources.name: Autodesk BODY DXF reference
sources.assessment: Documents the modeler subclass, group 70, group 1 and optional group 3 carrier; the reviewed entity table does not add the 3DSOLID history subclass.

sources.name: Autodesk REGION DXF reference
sources.assessment: Documents the modeler subclass, group 70, group 1 and optional group 3 carrier; it does not describe the modern DWG AcDs/SAB route.

sources.name: Local modeler parser, writer, and generated matrix
sources.assessment: Read-only inspection of src/drw_entities.cpp, src/libdxfrw.cpp, and tests/modeler_dxf_writer_matrix_tests.cpp found group-1/3 chunk preservation, caret decoding, version-specific inline-SAT versus AC1027 ACDSDATA/SAB paths, history-handle emission, ASCII/Binary lengths 254/255/256/509/510/511 for 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY across AC1015/1018/1021/1024, and export-import-export ordered-tag checks. This is self-consistency coverage, not independent producer acceptance.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1195
sources.assessment: Open issue reports silent DWG-to-DXF omission of ACIS-bearing 3DSOLID/REGION entities, including block-contained solids, on ACadSharp 3.4.9. It is not a runtime finding for the current release or libdxfrw.

sources.name: ACadSharp PR #1240
sources.assessment: Open, undeployed writer proposal for ACIS-dependent entities; not released capability evidence.

sources.name: ACadSharp release list
sources.assessment: Latest listed release at review time is v3.8.0 at 3a1c66b; the release page does not list the open #1240 writer work.

sources.name: LibreDWG issue #1411
sources.assessment: Open report provides a scratch-generated AC1032 DXF recipe with a 5,489-byte SAB and describes entity-shell survival with SAB/AcDs loss through exact LibreDWG build 0.14.8593 at 8a1ae764. A confidential R2018 example is not available and no runtime was executed in this review.

sources.name: LibreDWG NEWS
sources.assessment: Records a separate 0.14.1 final-SAT-block DXF export fix and continued incompleteness of AcDsPrototype_1b; these do not imply one another or establish current-master runtime behavior.

limitations: Source/document/test review only. No external DWG/DXF or issue attachment was downloaded; no peer was built or run; no native CAD application or geometry kernel was executed. Issue and release claims remain operation- and artifact-scoped.
